newsitem.title: UK: BT disclosures in UK lag U.S. -- paper.
newsitem.headline: BT disclosures in UK lag U.S. -- paper.

text.p: Several large shareholders in British Telecommunications Plc have been angered by receiving information about the company a month after it was released in the U.S., according to a report in the Financial Times.

BT's planned merger partner MCI Communications Corp released information in February showing profit projections for MCI as well as new salaries of BT chairman Sir Iain Vallance and chief executive Sir Peter Bonfield, the FT said.
The information was not released in Britain until last Friday, the paper said.
The paper quoted a BT spokesman as saying no one had been deliberately misinformed or not informed because of the lag and that there was "not one hint of irritation" from its institutional investors.
